description: We are SMARTBRAIN, a creative and passionate team with a strong interest in science, technology, and space exploration. Our project aims to introduce the history and development of NASA's space exploration technology through Apollo 11, Lunar Rover, Sojourner, Voyager, Hubble Space Telescope, and James Webb Space Telescope. We aim to create an engaging, creative, and informative visual experience that inspires young generations to explore science and discover the wonders of space.
